mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, will lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets price in stronger-than-expected economic growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO surprises positively by >0.5 standard deviations but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are in a simultaneous 3-month uptrend, it signals a broad-based consumer-led economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS in 3mo uptrends but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 1%, it indicates an inflationary environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) combined with a simultaneous drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market that is tightening too quickly, which will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE drops simultaneously but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is in a 3-month downtrend and the federal funds rate is above 3%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO in 3mo downtrend and FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.
